references.label: 20662 block 11

references.label: 20662 block 12
references.quote: “Block party” means a temporary gathering of area residents held on a blockaded

references.label: 20662 block 14

references.label: 20662 block 15

references.label: 20662 block 16
references.quote: including an unexpected loss of venue for an event. “Exigent circumstances” shall not

references.label: 20662 block 17

references.label: 20662 block 18

references.label: 20662 block 19

references.label: 20662 block 20

references.label: 20662 block 21
references.quote: “Neighborhood procession” means an organized procession of people, motor

references.label: 20662 block 22
references.quote: vehicles, bicycles, floats, animals or any combination, traveling in unison for a period of

references.label: 20662 block 23
references.quote: time that does not exceed two hours in length (from start through tear-down) along or

references.label: 20662 block 24
references.quote: upon a sidewalk or streets; provided, however, that at least 75 percent of the streets

references.label: 20662 block 25

references.label: 20662 block 26

references.label: 20662 block 27

references.label: 20662 block 28

references.label: 20662 block 29
references.quote: “Parade” means an organized procession of people, motor vehicles, bicycles,

references.label: 20662 block 30
references.quote: floats, animals or any combination, traveling in unison along or upon a sidewalk or any

references.label: 20662 block 31

references.label: 20662 block 32
references.quote: traffic by law enforcement to prevent a conflict with the normal or regular flow of traffic.

references.label: 20662 block 33

references.label: 20662 block 34
references.quote: “Person” means a natural person or legal entity such as but not limited to an

references.label: 20662 block 35

references.label: 20662 block 36
references.quote: “Police escort” means the assignment of law enforcement officers to provide a

references.label: 20662 block 37
references.quote: visibly authorized presence for public safety, traffic control, or to facilitate the movement

references.label: 20662 block 38

references.label: 20662 block 39

references.label: 20662 block 40
references.quote: owned by the City.

references.label: 20662 block 41
references.quote: “Special event” means an outdoor event held on public property organized for a

references.label: 20662 block 42
references.quote: particular and limited purpose and time. Special events shall include, but not be limited

references.label: 20662 block 43

references.label: 20662 block 44
references.quote: events, festivals and concerts.

references.label: 20662 block 46

references.label: 20662 block 47

references.label: 20662 block 49
